title: Graduation Thesis - International Economics
duration: 15 hours of theory, 135 hours of practice

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply fundamental knowledge of international economic relations, policies, and management.
Apply research methods and techniques to collect, analyze, and evaluate economic data.
Analyze, synthesize, and generalize issues, write and present reports to effectively solve economic problems.
Communicate and critically discuss professional content; work independently.
Identify and solve problems related to international economics.
Take initiative in planning and implementing research on international economic issues.
Propose solutions to emerging issues related to international economics.
Manage and complete a graduation thesis project.
Adhere to professional ethics and responsibilities during the internship and thesis process.
Meet deadlines and manage time effectively during the thesis process.
